news.title: Poll: Metro Surge impacted nearly three quarters of Minnesota educators
news.summary_en: Nearly three of four educators in Education Minnesota said in a new poll that they were directly or indirectly affected by Operation Metro Surge, suggesting a massive disruption in learning for tens of thousands of Minnesota…

news.title: Education Minnesota endorses Chapin, Osberg for Congress
news.summary_en: Education Minnesota has endorsed Doug Chapin in Minnesota’s 6th Congressional District and Erik Osberg in the 7th Congressional District.
